description: The file defines the interface for the CrosvmBuilder class used for configuring and building command lines for virtualization using crosvm, a virtual machine monitor for Chrome OS. It includes method declarations for adding various devices and configurations such as CPUs, disks, serial consoles, and vhost-user devices, along with some internal utility methods.

classes.name: cuttlefish::CrosvmBuilder
classes.description: Class providing builder methods to configure and generate crosvm command lines for VM setup.

methods.name: ApplyProcessRestarter
methods.description: Configures a process restarter with the crosvm binary, first run arguments, and exit code.

methods.name: AddControlSocket
methods.description: Adds a control socket to crosvm configuration.

methods.name: AddCpus
methods.description: Configures the number of CPUs either with a configuration path or a JSON value.

methods.name: AddHvcReadOnly
methods.description: Adds a read-only hypervisor console output with optional console parameter.

methods.name: AddHvcReadWrite
methods.description: Adds a writable hypervisor console with output and input parameters.

methods.name: AddKvmPath
methods.description: Specifies a path to the KVM device.

methods.name: AddSerialConsoleReadWrite
methods.description: Configures a read-write serial console with earlycon option.

methods.name: AddSerial
methods.description: Adds serial output and input (deprecated method).

methods.name: AddTap
methods.description: Adds a tap interface for networking; only available on Linux.

methods.name: AddVhostUser
methods.description: Adds a vhost-user device with specified type, socket path, and queue size.

methods.name: HvcNum
methods.description: Returns the number of HVC consoles.

methods.name: Cmd
methods.description: Returns a reference to the internal Command object used to build the command line.
